commands.start_run: {cmd:start_run, character:Ironclad|Silent|Defect|Regent|Necrobinder (required), seed? (missing/blank = random, reported in context.seed), ascension?:0-10 (default 0), lang?:en|zh (default en), manual_rewards?:bool (ignored: rewards are always decisions), omit_deck?:bool, modifiers?:[..], game_mode?, profile?:path}
commands.action: {cmd:action, action:<verb>, args:{...}} - send one entry of legal_actions as-is
commands.get_state: re-send the current decision (no game change)
commands.get_deck: {cmd:get_deck, upgrades?:bool} the deck with full card text
commands.get_piles: {cmd:get_piles, pile?:draw|discard|exhaust|hand|all} combat piles (draw pile sorted, order hidden)
commands.force_leave_room: NOT game behaviour: leave a softlocked room (softlocked:true, no legal actions); only with STS2_SOFTLOCK_ESCAPE=1

actions.play_card: {card_index, target_index? | target_id?} (a target is required for AnyEnemy cards when 2+ enemies; target_id = enemy combat_id)
actions.use_potion: {potion_index, target_index? | target_id?} (only when the potion's can_use is true)
actions.select_card_alternative: {alternative_index} card_reward alternatives other than Skip (Driftwood reroll, Pael's Wing sacrifice)
actions.select_cards: {indices:"0,2"} card_select; legal_actions gives choose:{from,min,max} for multi-picks
actions.skip_select: {} only when card_select has min_select 0 or cancelable true
actions.proceed: {} leave a rewards screen (not when its can_skip is false) / continue
actions.leave_room: {} leave a shop, a used rest site or a finished event page (alias of its Proceed option)
actions.crystal_sphere_click: {x, y, tool?:big|small} from choose_cell (no tool = current_tool)

notes: Every decision lists legal_actions; an action (verb and args) not listed is rejected with code illegal_action - nothing is chosen for you; only a missing target_index is filled in when a single entry matches. An argument the verb doesn't take is illegal_action; a null argument counts as absent. Every error has a code (bad_request, unknown_command, unknown_action, illegal_action, unknown_character, no_run, io_error, ...) and, while a run waits on a decision, decision and legal_actions. Aliases of the same button: finished event page leave_room|proceed = choose_option Proceed; rewards leave_room|skip_rewards = proceed; treasure proceed|leave_room = skip_treasure_relic; rest site/shop proceed = leave_room. 'events' lists what happened since the previous decision. A decision with softlocked:true has no legal action: the game shows no button there (the run can't go on).
